title: SurgeGuard · 1. Overview
description: Is everything OK, and is the waiting room protecting your origin? Health at a glance.

panels.title: Overall Status
panels.description: All systems operational. Click to view Reliability & Recovery.

targets.expr: clamp_max(  (max(redis_up{job="redis"}) or vector(0))  + (max(surgeguard_worker_is_leader) or vector(0))  + clamp_max(max(surgeguard_backends_healthy) or vector(0), 1),  2) * clamp_max(  (max(up{job="surgeguard-api"}) or vector(0))  * (max(redis_up{job="redis"}) or vector(0)),  1)

panels.title: Waiting Now
panels.description: Visitors currently waiting in the FIFO queue.

panels.title: Admission Rate
panels.description: Current rate of admitted visitors to origin.

panels.title: Healthy Backends
panels.description: Origin backends passing active health probes (2 of 2 healthy).

panels.title: Origin 5xx Error Rate
panels.description: Origin 5xx error ratio. Green <1%, amber 1-5%, red ≥5%.

panels.title: Edge Requests vs Admitted Origin Requests
panels.description: Public visitor traffic arriving at Nginx edge vs visitors admitted to origin. Filtered via clamp_min(rate - 0.4, 0).

panels.title: Queue Depth & Admission Capacity
panels.description: Visitors waiting in queue over time vs configured admission capacity target.

panels.title: Origin Latency Percentiles
panels.description: Response time percentiles (p50, p95, p99) for requests executing at origin backends.

panels.title: Origin 5xx Error Rate
panels.description: Percentage of requests returning HTTP 5xx errors from protected backends.

panels.title: Backend Health & Probe Latency
panels.description: Active health check probe status, roundtrip latency, and traffic distribution across backends.

panels.title: Request Outcomes
panels.description: Breakdown of visitor outcomes: admitted to origin, queued in line, rejected, or expired.

panels.title: Redis Memory Usage
panels.description: Memory consumed by Redis for session tokens and queues (512 MB max limit).

panels.title: Admission Worker
panels.description: Admission worker daemon state. Running = active leader loop.

panels.title: Cluster Components
panels.description: Scrape status of all SurgeGuard dependencies. Green = UP, Red = DOWN.

list.name: Events
list.textFormat: Backend probe transition, admission pause/resume, or leader change
